Comment: GP Shop items organized by categories from the original Dragon's Dogma Online server.
14=Storage Expansion (permanent item bag upgrades), 15=Event & Collab Items
Course tickets (LineupId 1001+) have CourseId > 0 and DurationSeconds set.
When purchased, they are added to the player's available courses list.
Duration constants: 1 day=86400, 7 days=604800, 30 days=2592000, 90 days=7776000
